results.title: The Farmer Companies Raises $17M, Names Dot's Pretzels Veteran CEO | C-Store News
highlights:
Burlington, Vt.-based The Farmer Companies has closed a $17 million Series A financing and appointed Randy Johnson as chief executive officer, positioning the premium cheese snacking platform for national scale behind its WHISPS and Cabot Creamery Popcorn brands. Founder Adam Farmer steps into a Chairman role, retaining board influence while handing day-to-day operations to Johnson.
...
The round was led by Raff Ventures, the direct private investment arm of Rafferty Holdings, with participation from AJAX Capital Partners. Proceeds will fund manufacturing partnerships, national distribution buildout, and potential follow-on acquisitions, according to the company.
...
The infusion of $17 million in growth capital, paired with a CEO whose prior company commanded a $1.2 billion exit, signals The Farmer Companies intends to push distribution aggressively. For c-store buyers scouting the snack aisle, that likely means broader promotional support, improved fill rates through manufacturing investment, and the kind of field-sales infrastructure that only materializes after a meaningful capital raise.

results.title: Former Dot's Pretzels CEO Randy Johnson tapped to lead The Farmer Companies as it completes $17 Million Series A Financing | The Farmer Companies
results.author: The Farmer Companies
highlights:
Former Dot's Pretzels CEO Randy Johnson tapped to lead The Farmer Companies as it completes $17 Million Series A Financing | The Farmer Companies
...
A new chapter begins! Today, The Farmer Companies announced the appointment of Randy Johnson as Chief Executive Officer and the successful close of a $17 million Series A financing. Randy's track record speaks for itself. He helped transform Dot's Pretzels into one of the fastest-growing brands in snacking, leading the business from $19 million to $250 million in annual sales before its acquisition by Hershey. His experience building brands, developing teams, and scaling businesses makes him the ideal leader for our next chapter. At The Farmer Companies, we're building a portfolio of exceptional food brands through acquisitions and strategic partnerships, with a primary focus on becoming the leader in premium cheese snacking. We believe the category is still in its early innings, and we're excited about the opportunities ahead to bring consumers innovative, high-quality products from some of the world's most iconic brands. We're grateful to our employees, customers, retail partners, suppliers, investors, and everyone who has believed in our vision. Your support has made this milestone possible, and we're excited for what comes next. Please join us in welcoming Randy to The Farmer Companies! https://lnkd.in/eBxqXfsF
